en: A vintage black‑and‑white interior photograph showing an elegantly furnished bedroom in a historic hotel. The room has patterned wallpaper, a large padded bed in the foreground, an ornate wardrobe with mirrored doors, a dressing table with a mirror, and a small seating area with two upholstered chairs and a round table with a fringed cloth. Heavy curtains hang on the right. The lower margin bears handwritten-style captions indicating the hotel name, city, and that this is a bedroom.
